The first time each of your turns a Skill [gold]Stuns[/gold] an enemy, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] at the start of your next turn.

The first time each of your turns a card other than Swift Battle Will played from your [gold]hand[/gold] fully resolves with at most 2 cards left in your hand, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].

WYLDER_PURSUIT_STANCE:
每个你的回合首次通过出牌消耗[gold]追击[/gold]后，若该牌是攻击牌，获得{Energy:energyIcons()}；若是技能牌，获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]。
同名效果合计最多获得1点能量或20点基础[gold]格挡[/gold]。

WYLDER_FIERY_BLOOD: 每个你的回合首次通过卡牌直接获得[gold]活力[/gold]后，额外获得{Vigor:diff()}点[gold]活力[/gold]。
The first time each of your turns you gain [gold]Vigor[/gold] directly from a card effect, gain {Vigor:diff()} additional [gold]Vigor[/gold].
WYLDER_UNYIELDING_SPIRIT: 在两次你的回合开始之间，首次因敌人的攻击失去生命后，获得{Block:diff()}点[gold]格挡[/gold]并进入[gold]追击[/gold]。
Between the starts of your turns, the first time an enemy attack causes you to lose HP, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] and enter [gold]Pursuit[/gold].

每个你的回合，第一张具有[gold]破势[/gold]的攻击牌[gold]破势[/gold]阈值降低{Reduction:diff()}，最低为1。
无论是否成功[gold]破势[/gold]，均消耗此次资格。

WYLDER_EMBER_RESERVE_POWER:
按整回合首次真实攻击消耗活力计数；部署前已消耗也占资格。
整张牌完成后统一获得格挡。

The first real attack consumption of Vigor counts even before deployment.
Block is granted after the whole card resolves.
WYLDER_CLASH_EMBERS_POWER:
整回合第一张攻击开始时即占资格，即使没有命中。
后部署不会补发；活力在整张牌结算后获得。

The first Attack claims eligibility when it begins, even if it misses.
Deploying later does not grant the reward retroactively; Vigor is gained after the whole card.
WYLDER_OPENING_HUNT_POWER:
全回合首次成功破势计数，部署前也占资格。
击杀不取消奖励；整张攻击及其自身奖励后抽牌，升级副本额外给予2点活力。

The first successful Break counts even before deployment.
A killing blow still qualifies; rewards follow the whole attack and its own effects, with 2 Vigor per upgraded copy.
WYLDER_WINDWARD_STANCE_POWER:
只在本能力已部署时消费首次资格。
重新进入追击也触发；格挡在本牌效果与旧追击补抽后获得。

Eligibility begins when this Power is deployed.
Reentry qualifies; Block follows card effects and the old Pursuit draw.
WYLDER_BATTLE_INSTINCT_POWER:
只计算从手牌实际打出的攻击；手牌自动打出可触发，外部重放不触发。
等关联抽牌完成后检查唯一技能，不满足条件不消耗资格。

Only Attacks actually played from hand qualify, including hand autoplay but not external replays.
Check for the single Skill after all related draws; failed conditions do not spend eligibility.
WYLDER_BLOOD_STILL_HOT_POWER:
首次实际获得活力包含卡牌与能力来源，部署前也占资格。
玩家回合外不计；攻击内奖励延迟到整张牌完成。

The first actual Vigor gain counts card and Power sources, including gains before deployment.
Enemy-turn gains do not count; rewards inside attacks wait until the whole card finishes.
WYLDER_FLAME_GUARD_STANCE_POWER:
只统计原生攻击实际消耗的活力，不统计技能主动失去的活力。
新追击在整张牌后获得，不增强该牌后续段数。

Only Vigor actually consumed by the native attack counts, not direct Skill losses.
New Pursuit is granted after the whole card and cannot enhance its remaining hits.
WYLDER_PURSUIT_COMMAND_POWER:
卡牌直接进入或重入追击才计数；能力和遗物不计。
部署前的首次卡内进入也占资格，同名能力每回合合计最多抽2张牌。

Only a card's direct entry or reentry into Pursuit counts, not Powers or Relics.
The first such entry counts even before deployment; all copies together draw at most 2 cards per turn.
WYLDER_BATTLEFIELD_MIGHT_POWER:
首次成功破势按全回合计数，击杀仍奖励。
力量在整张攻击后获得，不增强该牌后续段数。

The first successful Break counts across the whole turn; kills still reward.
Strength is granted after the whole attack and cannot boost its remaining hits.
WYLDER_GUARD_RESURGENCE_POWER:
只记录技能实际成功的眩晕，手牌自动弹反可触发。
锁定触发时的副本数量，下回合基础资源初始化后发放；之后增加副本不追溯。

Only a Skill's successful Stun qualifies, including Parry autoplayed from hand.
The reward snapshots copies at trigger time and is paid after next turn's base resources initialize.
WYLDER_SWIFT_BATTLE_WILL_POWER:
首次资格按全回合最终结算顺序计数；部署前满足条件也占资格。
所有同名迅捷战意出牌均排除，手牌外重放排除。
追击补抽与相关能力抽牌全部完成后才检查。

The first qualifying settlement counts even before deployment.
Every Swift Battle Will card and every external replay is excluded.
The check occurs after all Pursuit and related Power draws.
WYLDER_RUINOUS_GHOSTFLAME_POWER:
对单个敌人造成超过20点的攻击伤害时，给予2层[gold]冻伤[/gold]（升级为3层）。
伤害在扣除格挡前计算，多段分别判断。

Whenever an attack hit deals more than 20 damage to an enemy, apply 2 [gold]Freeze[/gold] (3 when upgraded).
Check each hit separately before Block.
WYLDER_PURSUIT_STANCE_POWER:
消费的是本次出牌前的旧追击，不要求状态实例移除。
能力牌也占首次消费资格，但不给攻击或技能奖励。
同名效果攻击分支最多1能量，技能分支基础格挡最多20，敏捷仅统一作用一次。

Consumes the old Pursuit eligibility even if the status instance survives reentry.
Power cards spend the first-consumption opportunity without an Attack or Skill reward.
All copies grant at most 1 Energy or 20 base Block, with Dexterity applied once.
WYLDER_FIERY_BLOOD_POWER:
只计算卡内直接实际获得活力。
先锁定首次资格，再由本能力追加；不响应能力间接获得，不能递归触发自身。

Only actual Vigor gained directly by a card counts.
Eligibility is locked before this Power's extra gain; indirect Power gains cannot trigger it recursively.
WYLDER_VETERAN_EDGE_POWER: 每次触发[gold]破势[/gold]后，每层此能力获得2点[gold]力量[/gold]。
Whenever you trigger [gold]Break[/gold], gain 2 [gold]Strength[/gold] per stack.
WYLDER_UNYIELDING_SPIRIT_POWER:
每次玩家回合开始重置。
敌方多段攻击首段实际失血后立即获得格挡，保护后续段，不抵销已受到的伤害。

Resets at the start of each player turn.
Block is granted immediately after the first enemy hit that causes HP loss, protecting later hits but not undoing damage already taken.
WYLDER_NIGHT_EDGE_POWER:
首张有破势攻击按全回合计数，包含自动打出、重放及部署前的攻击，未达标也消费减阈值资格。
首成功破势是独立资格，活力在整张牌后获得。
同名减阈值和活力分别取最高，不相加。

The first Attack with Break counts across the turn, including autoplay, replay and attacks before deployment; failure still spends its threshold reduction.
The first successful Break is independent and awards Vigor after the whole card.
Use the strongest threshold reduction and Vigor reward across copies, not their sum.
